class.name: ResourceLazyLoader
class.brief_description: Resources loaded when they are wanted and let go when nobody wants them.
class.description: Holds the resources needed only while something near the camera uses them - a scenery's models, its terrain - so their memory, RAM and the VRAM of a mesh or a texture, goes back once nothing holds them. A resource is registered under a key with the [Callable] that loads it; one key is one resource, shared by everybody who registers it. [method resource_load] loads a copy, [method resource_hold] holds it, [method resource_release] lets it go. A copy not held is not shared: each load loads it anew. Everything held is let go when the game's data is unloaded ([signal GameDataServer.data_unload_requested]). Thread-safe. With [member lazy_loading] a resource is loaded when it is wanted and let go once nobody holds it. Without it - the default - it is loaded when its key is registered first and kept until its last registration is freed; holding and releasing it then only says who builds from it.

method.name: resource_free
method.description: Frees one registration; the resource goes with the last one.

method.name: resource_hold
method.description: Holds the resource until the matching [method resource_release] and returns the copy held: the one somebody already holds, or else [param loaded], a copy from [method resource_load].

method.name: resource_is_resident
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while somebody holds the resource.

method.name: resource_load
method.description: Returns the held resource, or loads a new copy without holding it - for a worker preparing what the main thread then holds with [method resource_hold].

method.name: resource_register
method.description: Registers the resource [param loader] ([code]() -> Resource[/code]) loads. The same [param key] gives the same RID; each registration is freed by its own [method resource_free].

method.name: resource_release
method.description: Lets go of a resource held by [method resource_hold]; once nobody holds it, the loader keeps no reference of its own.

members.member: Read when the loader is created from the project setting [code]maszyna/resources/lazy_loading[/code], and [code]true[/code] whatever it says with the [code]--enable-lazy-loading[/code] command-line switch. A change takes effect on the keys registered after it; a key registered already keeps its mode.
